concepts.name: Signal Bridge
concepts.question: What needs attention while the fleet is running?
concepts.omits: Detailed time history and workspace paths.
concepts.tradeoff: Strong overview; narrow width becomes a selected session register.
concepts.data: Current synthetic sessions, human questions and source ages.
concepts.missing: Missing source evidence remains unknown, never healthy by default.

concepts.name: Fleet Quilt
concepts.question: How is observed work distributed across owners?
concepts.omits: Per-session evidence packets and workspace paths.
concepts.tradeoff: Membership cells make uneven ownership visible; narrow mode selects one strip.
concepts.data: One literal cell per visible session, grouped by declared owner.
concepts.missing: Unknown lifecycle has its own marker; hidden records are counted.

concepts.name: Time Loom
concepts.question: Where did observed time go?
concepts.omits: Cost, resource use and admission evidence.
concepts.tradeoff: Comparable lanes require a fixed window and fewer visible sessions.
concepts.data: Twenty observed three-minute buckets, never inferred completion.
concepts.missing: Missing buckets are gaps, not inactivity or failure.

concepts.name: Worktree Atlas
concepts.question: Which sessions occupy which workspaces?
concepts.omits: Cross-owner dependencies and full session timelines.
concepts.tradeoff: Workspace-first directory prioritizes shared and unmapped membership.
concepts.data: Explicit session-worktree joins, paths, revisions and policy fields.
concepts.missing: Unmapped sessions remain visible; absent dirty state is unknown.

concepts.name: Decision Desk
concepts.question: Which human question is waiting, and who is affected?
concepts.omits: Unaffected session inventory and resource telemetry.
concepts.data: Observed requests with explicit owner, age, evidence scope and affected sessions.
concepts.missing: No requests does not imply complete message coverage.

concepts.name: Proof Gate
concepts.question: Which evidence describes the current revision?
concepts.omits: Full task inventory and elapsed-time tracks.
concepts.data: Session revision, check revision, report, review, tests, result and admission.
concepts.missing: Missing checks remain unknown; an unmatched check cannot certify the current head.

concepts.name: Budget Engine
concepts.question: How much measured spend is visible, and what is missing?
concepts.omits: No invented budget, forecast or token-progress estimate.
concepts.tradeoff: Partial-cost honesty over a single reassuring total.
concepts.data: Recorded session USD, measurement coverage, window and owner; sampled resource coverage.
concepts.missing: Unmeasured costs are excluded from the subtotal, never replaced by zero spend.

concepts.name: Relay Map
concepts.question: Which recorded dependency crosses owner boundaries?
concepts.omits: Inferred relationships and generic all-to-all wiring.
concepts.tradeoff: Legible evidence-backed routes over exhaustive session visibility.
concepts.data: Only explicit fixture edges with source, target, affected sessions and evidence.
concepts.missing: Absent relationships remain unknown rather than disconnected by assertion.

concepts.name: Delta Deck
concepts.question: What explicitly changed since the saved baseline?
concepts.omits: Static fleet inventory and inferred resolutions.
concepts.tradeoff: Change recognition over full current-state coverage.
concepts.data: Normalized event IDs and sequence, explicit kind, reference and previous snapshot.
concepts.missing: No baseline is labeled unavailable; silence cannot resolve an item.

concepts.name: Watchkeeper
concepts.question: Which observations are missing or need attention?
concepts.omits: Work throughput rankings and inferred healthy verdicts.
concepts.tradeoff: Coverage uncertainty stays visible even when records look quiet.
concepts.data: Source freshness and coverage plus explicit session exceptions and retry provenance.
concepts.missing: Unknown, stale and failed remain distinct; missing messages never mean no requests.
